app.notes:
Skip a long intro or interlude: tap Skip on the stage, press OK on a TV remote, or use the phone remote
Voice cut for MP3s and videos: VOICE on the keypad takes the singer out and keeps the bass and drums
Find lyrics online for any song, timed for MP3s and ready to tap-time for MIDI
Make an MP3 into karaoke in one go: copied in, voice cut, timed lyrics found
A songbook PDF made on the phone, with every song and number, to print or share; guests can download it
Your own songs keep their numbers when you add more
New History and Added tabs in My Songs
Count-in sound: a click, a woodblock or a voice on each count
Guests can send a message to the screen from their phones
Guests Are Limited: guests add songs to the end and control only their own; the host does the rest
Send songs, lyrics, SoundFonts and photos from a phone or computer on the same Wi-Fi
Recordings save as small M4A files in Recordings › Mic-Key, with Listen, Share and Delete
Record Video Too: films the stage, never the keypad or menus, into Movies › Mic-Key
Recording Voice Timing for Bluetooth microphones and speakers
Stage on the TV: with HDMI or screen mirroring, the TV shows the stage and the phone becomes the controller
Use this phone as the remote: finds the stage on the Wi-Fi, and scores your singing with this phone's mic
Bluetooth Remote for places with no Wi-Fi or hotspot
The join code stays the same, so phones that joined before are still in
Auto Sound Quality keeps the music smooth on slow TV boxes
Phone's Sound Effects: Dolby, Wavelet and other equalizer apps can shape Mic-Key's sound
A SoundFont that closes the app is set aside, and a broken one falls back to the built-in sound
Music Between Songs from your mp3s folder, fading out for each song
Problem Report in Settings, and sample contents can download to an SD card
A calculator in Party, Tools, and voice search understands Filipino and English
Downloading several sample contents no longer stops at the first one that fails: the rest still come, and the window says which didn't
TVs with no install settings page can update from inside the app
